prompt: What is blocking delivery on this Project right now? Search and read the Evidence, then answer with your sources cited.
answer:
Currently, there are a few blockers affecting delivery on the project:

1. The completion of the settlement service has been delayed, with a new forecast of readiness by 2026-10-05 due to customer credentials issues. This was highlighted in the "Acme progress report", which noted that Deliverable A is 90% complete and is blocked by this credential issue ([Acme progress report](https://example.com)).

2. Jason reported that the integration testing is at risk of being delayed unless there are no further infrastructure blocks. The revised API completion is expected by 2026-10-01. This information was discussed in the "Weekly sync minutes", where it was stated that UAT is still targeted for 2026-10-07, but team dependency on the staging API is a concern ([Weekly sync minutes](https://example.com)).

3. A status update reported that the schedule for API completion has shifted from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-01, indicating that downstream testing is now starting late and that the start for UAT is under review. This update highlighted a risk concerning vendor access being raised to high priority, reflecting the urgency around credential issues with Acme ([Status update — week 37](https://example.com)).

These issues point to the need for escalating requests for IAM credentials with Acme to resolve these blockers.

prompt: Compare what the weekly minutes and the vendor report each say about when the settlement service will be done, and cite both sources.
answer:
The weekly sync minutes state that the settlement service will be ready by 2026-09-30 according to Marcus from Acme, who noted they are still waiting for IAM credentials which has caused delays. In contrast, the Acme progress report claims that the settlement service is 90% complete, with a planned finish of 2026-09-26, but now forecasts completion by 2026-10-05 due to a blockage with customer credentials.
